crossRefs.note: He said, “Call his name Lo-Ammi; for you are not my people, and I will not be yours.
Yet the number of the children of Israel will be as the sand of the sea, which can’t be measured or counted; and it…
As he says also in Hosea, “I will call them ‘my people,’ which were not my people; and her ‘beloved,’ who was not…
“It will be that in the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ there they will be called ‘children…
I will sow her to me in the earth; and I will have mercy on her who had not obtained mercy; and I will tell those who…
And if by grace, then it is no longer of works; otherwise grace is no longer grace. But if it is of works, it is no…
What then? That which Israel seeks for, that he didn’t obtain, but the chosen ones obtained it, and the rest were…
For as you in time past were disobedient to God, but now have obtained mercy by their disobedience,
Now concerning virgins, I have no commandment from the Lord, but I give my judgment as one who has obtained mercy from…
although I used to be a blasphemer, a persecutor, and insolent. However, I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly…
Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help…

translations.web: In the past, you were not a people, but now are God’s people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
translations.bsb: Once you were not a people, but now you are the people of God; once you had not received mercy, but now you have received mercy.
translations.kjv: Which in time past were not a people, but are now the people of God: which had ➔ not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
translations.asv: who in time past were no people, but now are the people of God: who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
